hints.title: What is a feedforward term?
hints.content: A feedforward term is a constant power offset added to the driver's input to counteract a known disturbance — in this case, gravity pulling the arm down. Without it, the driver must constantly hold the stick up just to keep the arm stationary.

hints.title: The formula
hints.content: Simply add the two values: `double power = stick + GRAVITY_COMP;` Then set `armMotor.setPower(power);`. When the driver releases the stick (stick = 0), the motor still outputs GRAVITY_COMP (0.1) to hold the arm up.

hints.title: Tuning the constant
hints.content: Start with a small value like 0.05–0.15 and increase until the arm holds steady with no stick input. The right value depends on arm weight, length, and gear ratio.
